people.name: Elealeh
people.line: Moabite city assigned to Reuben; later prophecies of destruction

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
translations.bsb: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voices are heard as far as Jahaz. Therefore the soldiers of Moab cry out; their souls tremble within.
translations.kjv: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous
translations.asv: And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; their voice is heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul trembleth within him.
